title: glandularia setacea
intro: Glandularia setacea, commonly known as Rose Verbena or Purple Verbena, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. It is native to South America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Glandularia setacea include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils.
